title: Home & Hometown
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1 · Nơi ở và quê hương

questions.question: What do you like most about your hometown?

followUps.reason: Why is that your favourite thing?
followUps.example: Could you describe a specific place?
followUps.detail: Has that place changed over time?

questions.question: Is your hometown a good place for young people?

followUps.example: Can you give an example of an activity for young people?

questions.question: Do you prefer living in a house or an apartment?

followUps.example: Can you describe your ideal living space?
followUps.detail: What might be one disadvantage of your choice?

questions.question: Would you like to live somewhere else in the future?

followUps.example: What is one place you would consider?
followUps.detail: What would you miss about your current home?
